text:
Maya (Partnerships): Quick heads-up — kickoff for a 2-week systems integrator knowledge-transfer sprint with OmniCore next Tue 9am PT. Primary goals: certify 3 SI engineers on our Dedicated + Marketplace integration, hand off the onboarding runbook, and run one joint deploy test.
Aj (SI Ops): I can lead the deploy test and set up a disposable lab. What hardware should I provision? A100 or H100?
Maya (Partnerships): @Aj aim for real-world parity: H100 for the primary lab (matching OmniCore's infra) and A100 pool for scale tests. Keep costs limited — short-lived nodes only.
Liam (Solutions): I’ll prepare the integration checklist and the sample terraform. Plan to include RBAC steps, KMS hints, and model pinning example.
Sofia (Training): I’ll own the certification rubric + two hands-on workshops (day 2: Dedicated ops; day 6: Marketplace & SI manifest). Draft agenda below — feedback welcome:
```
Day 0: Preflight (credentials, VPN, IAM permissions)
Day 1: Dedicated basics + latency/cost tradeoffs
Day 2: Hands-on: spin Dedicated cluster, deploy model variant
Day 3: Observability + rollouts (canary/A-B)
Day 4: Marketplace connector & HW attestation
Day 5: Joint deploy rehearsal
Day 6: Certification lab + Q&A
```
Maya (Partnerships): Nice — add a small section on fallback policies (model variant switchover) and failure drills. Also include the legal checklist link: https://redwood.example.com/si-onboarding/legal-checklist
Aj (SI Ops): For the lab, I’ll post the ip ranges and a Docker command to run the sample runtime. Quick snippet for infra team:
```
terraform apply -var='gpu_type=h100' -auto-approve
docker run --env-file .env redwood/runtime:stable ./start --mode=lab
```
Liam (Solutions): Can we make one of the lab exercises simulate quota exhaustion so the SI practices routing to fallback model? Simple load script should do it.
Sofia (Training): Yep — I’ll add a script and a short rubric for grading resiliency. Also proposing a 45-min pre-workshop async module on our console dashboards (recorded).
Maya (Partnerships): Who can attend the first dry run on Mon 2pm PT? Need at least one partner-facing PM and an infra lead.
Aj (SI Ops): I’m in.
Liam (Solutions): I can make it.
Sofia (Training): I’ll present the rubric.
ops-bot: Reminder: lab cluster quota request created (#REQ-3427). ETA for nodes: 3 hours. :white_check_mark:
Maya (Partnerships): Perfect. After the dry run we’ll finalize the playbook and the cert badge criteria. Thanks team — I’ll DM OmniCore to confirm attendees and send calendar invites. :rocket:
